cause: A pre-execution review compared the proposed adapter projection with the protected G1/T2 max_action_delta initializer. The draft used the later winner-v3 variable-configuration vector, which would have changed protected winner-v2 yaw, roll, neck, and head outputs and therefore made the required default-off identity impossible.
corrected_rule: Use the selected winner-v2 deployment action vector already stored in both protected G1/T2 checkpoints: [5.24,5.24,1.5,1.5,1.5,5.24,5.24,5.24,5.24,5.24,5.24,1.25,1.0,1.25] rad/s. The new graph must reproduce the protected max_action_delta initializer exactly.
